changes.title: Trump declares 100 percent tariffs on many drones and all aircraft parts
changes.summary: The United States has already banned future foreign drones from entering the United States unless their companies kiss the ring - as well as routers , robots , and Roombas . Now, President Donald Trump is targeting existing drone imports and parts, too. He's going to try to make them cost a lot more. In a presidential.

changes.title: U.S. Investigated Left-Leaning Groups During Minnesota Immigration Crackdown
changes.summary: The government conducted expansive surveillance, infiltrated group chats and obtained financial records of organizations never accused of crimes.

changes.title: Record-breaking heat takes mounting toll on the U.S. economy
changes.summary: Heat waves are dealing a financial blow to businesses and creating hazardous conditions for workers, according to climate experts.

changes.title: Sailors and their families have lives on hold, uncertain if they'll return to Mideast
changes.summary: Sailors and family members who were evacuated from U.S. bases in the Middle East months ago are waiting for the military to figure out what will happen to the lives they left behind. (Image credit: Fadhel Madhan).

changes.title: Trump Gives Green Light to U.S. Companies to Aim Hacks at Cybercriminals
changes.summary: The practice would align the United States more closely with countries like China and Russia, where spy agencies have long relied on private-sector hackers to help with national security missions.

changes.title: Trump’s Immigration Policy Echoes 1920s Crackdown, but This Time Congress Isn’t Involved
changes.summary: U.S. leaders limited immigration amid economic and social turmoil. Historians see similarities to Trump’s crackdown, with a catch: He’s doing it without Congress.

changes.title: Inside the Democratic Socialists of America’s Audacious Quest for Power
changes.summary: Democratic Socialists are capturing more votes than ever before — even as they run up against the limits of their appeal.

changes.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to head home amid concerns about living conditions
changes.summary: A U.S official told NBC News that the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln is set to head home from the Mideast. It comes as some families report poor living conditions for the sailors and marines on board. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

changes.title: U.S. Ambassador Huckabee condemns ‘Israeli terrorists’ for siege of West Bank homes
changes.summary: Dozens of Israeli settlers have trapped two Palestinian families in their West Bank homes for days, cutting off food, water and electricity. Their actions even drawing the ire of U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee. The IDF says settlers were dispersed, but some remain. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports from the occup.

changes.title: AIPAC didn't always spend on campaigns. Now it faces criticism over money in politics
changes.summary: U.S. support for Israel has been a central issue in Democratic primary contests. That's put a spotlight on the pro-Israel lobbying group AIPAC and the strength of its political influence.
